Diabetes130US.name: Diabetes130US
Diabetes130US.notes: Grinsztajn et al. 2022 benchmark (OpenML 45022; original OpenML 4541, UCI 296, Strack et al. 2014). Not the UCI <30-day task: >30-day readmission vs none, 7 numeric utilisation counts, classes balanced at 35,545 (the <30 class dropped, NO undersampled; worked out from the counts).

MagicTelescope.name: MagicTelescope
MagicTelescope.notes: Grinsztajn et al. 2022 benchmark (OpenML 44125); original OpenML 1120, UCI MAGIC Gamma Telescope (Bock et al. 2004).

accelerometer.name: accelerometer
accelerometer.notes: UCI 846; 3 configurations, 51,000 rows each (already balanced). No published reference accuracy for this task.

changes.detail: V12: call duration, known only after the call; leaks the label

bank_marketing.name: bank_marketing
bank_marketing.notes: Grinsztajn et al. 2022 numerical classification benchmark (OpenML 44126); original OpenML 1461, UCI 222 (Bank Marketing).

california.name: california
california.notes: Grinsztajn et al. 2022 numerical classification benchmark (OpenML 44090); original cal_housing (Torgo), regression target binarised by the benchmark.

changes.detail: sparse columns stored densely, values unchanged

codrna.name: codrna
codrna.notes: LIBSVM cod-rna benchmark (OpenML 351). About 30% duplicate rows, kept as published; they raise FEC's cache hit rate.

covertype.name: covertype
covertype.notes: Grinsztajn et al. 2022 benchmark binary version (OpenML 44121): the two largest classes, balanced; original OpenML 293, UCI Covertype.

credit.name: credit
credit.notes: Grinsztajn et al. 2022 numerical classification benchmark (OpenML 44089); original Kaggle 'Give Me Some Credit' (cs-training.csv).

dry_bean.name: dry_bean
dry_bean.notes: UCI 602, Koklu & Ozkan 2020; 7 classes. Reference: SVM accuracy 0.931 (original paper).

electricity.name: electricity
electricity.notes: Grinsztajn et al. 2022 benchmark (OpenML 44120); original OpenML 151, Harries 1999 elec2. `date` kept, as in the benchmark.

electricity_cat.name: electricity_cat
electricity_cat.notes: Grinsztajn et al. 2022 categorical classification benchmark (OpenML 44156); original OpenML 151 (Harries 1999 elec2); the numerical suite's version is `electricity` (44120).

house_16H.name: house_16H
house_16H.notes: Grinsztajn et al. 2022 numerical classification benchmark (OpenML 44123); original OpenML 821.

iris.name: iris
iris.notes: PMLB iris (Fisher 1936); 3 classes, 4 numeric features. Multiclass test dataset.

changes.detail: d2_a1_b1_mmdt: identical to d2_b1_mmdt in every row

lhc_jets.name: lhc_jets
lhc_jets.notes: hls4ml LHC jet tagging, 16 high-level features; 5 classes. Reference: about 0.75 accuracy in the hls4ml papers (to be confirmed from the paper).

phoneme_balanced.name: phoneme_balanced
phoneme_balanced.notes: Grinsztajn et al. 2022 numerical classification benchmark (OpenML 44127); original OpenML 1489. Named phoneme_balanced: PMLB's `phoneme` (5,404 rows) is a different table; the benchmark balanced it to 3,172.

changes.detail: V3: declared nominal -> numeric (0-10 levels like V0-V12; PMLB's profile page and OpenML treat all 13 as numeric, only metadata.yaml tags V3 categorical)

sleep.name: sleep
sleep.notes: PMLB sleep; 5 classes; no source, description or publication in PMLB's metadata. All 13 features numeric (V3 overridden). No published reference accuracy found (not on UCI or OpenML).

wine_quality.name: wine_quality
wine_quality.notes: Grinsztajn et al. 2022 numerical classification benchmark (OpenML 44091); original UCI Wine Quality, regression target binarised by the benchmark. Named wine_quality: `wine` in DataComplexity is the classic 3-class UCI Wine (178 rows).
